column1: # /Graph Save SVG — Pie wedge labels come from /Graph X cell text.
# Slice F (pie labels) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. Before this slice draw_pie
# labelled wedges with positional indices ("1", "2", …). The X-range
# in 1-2-3 R3.4a names the categorical axis; for a Pie it's the
# label per wedge. Cell text under the X range now flows through
# GraphValues.x_labels and into the rendered SVG.
# Seed A1..A3 = label text (entered as labels, not numbers).
# /GA over B1..B3 — values series. POINT-prompt anchor is the cell
# pointer at the time /GA is pressed, so move to B1 first.
# /GS — save SVG to a temp file; the wedge label text should land
